versions.changelog:
Initial release of electrical-schematic-review:

- Enables systematic review of electrical schematics (EPLAN and similar) using standardized checklists.
- Supports PDF input for schematics and Excel/templates for review records.
- Automates checklist-driven review across safety, main, control, PLC/IO, servo, and communication circuits.
- Generates standardized audit reports in Excel or PDF, preserving original templates and highlighting issue severity.
- Includes quick reference tables for safety, main circuit, and PLC review points.
